text:
jamie: FYI merged nimblehealth/lora-quant into main — used q4_0 + per-channel rounding. kicking off nimble quick-eval pack (/evals run nimble-quickpack)
ashwin: nice. tokenizer same as prod? any vocab edits in the LoRA?
mia: tokenizer unchanged, used prod vocab. training logs show a few OOVs but nothing major.
jamie: eval running on our dedicated pool (g4dn-sim). will paste summary.
eval-bot: QuickEval: nimble-quickpack finished on main@nimble-lora-4bit
  summary: 75/90 checks passed, 15 flagged, 0 crashes
  regressions: entity-extraction F1 avg drop 2.8% (baseline 92.3 -> 89.5)
  hotspots: currency parsing, negative amounts, invoice-id hallucination up x1.8
  artifacts: /artifacts/nimble/1754329876/quick-eval-diffs.html
noah: 2.8% drop on invoices is rough. per-field breakdown?
jamie: pack breakdown:
  - amount: -4.6% F1
  - currency: -3.9% F1
  - invoice_id: -1.2% F1, hallucinations in free-text up
  note: generation entropy slightly higher post-quant, esp tail tokens.
nashwin: sounds like quant noise on output projection. did we quantize output layers?
mia: whole model q4_0 by default; out projection was quantized.
jamie: repro prompt (sanitized):
```
Customer: NimbleHealth
Task: extract invoice meta from OCR text
Input: "Invoice # 3421
Total: $1,234.56 USD
Date: 2025-01-08"
Expected: {"invoice_id":"3421","amount":"1234.56","currency":"USD"}
Model: returned invoice_id:"3421", amount:"1234.56 usd", currency:"US dollars", note:"charged on 2025-01-08"
```
noah: casing/tokenization minor but shouldn't flip currency tokens. likely softer logits.
nashwin: options:
  1) re-export mixed quant: keep output/projection fp16, rest 4-bit
  2) PTQ per-channel on first/last linears
  3) canary 5% traffic and monitor Console regression alerts
jamie: I'll do (1) quickly — re-export with outproj fp16 and re-run quickpack.
mia: also add a small currency-canonicalization exact-match test to the quickpack as a fast guard.
eval-bot: note: nimble invoice rollback threshold = 3% F1 drop. current = 2.8% (borderline).
ops-bot: created ticket ML-1428: "nimblehealth 4bit LoRA regression" assigned to jamie. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-1428
nashwin: keep canary gating strict. if next run >3% we rollback and schedule per-layer quant A/B.
jamie: running mixed-quant export now; will post results in ~15m :eyes:
mia: will patch quickpack with the currency exact-match test before the rerun.
jamie: ack — updating ticket with artifacts and plan. :thumbsup:
